title: Part-Time Language Intervention Coach (Upper Primary and Lower Secondary)
snippet: We are inviting applications for a Language Intervention Coach to support Upper Primary and Lower Secondary students' English language development.
label: 英语教学
full_jd:
We are inviting applications for a Language Intervention Coach to support Upper Primary and Lower Secondary students who require targeted assistance with English language development.

The successful candidate will be available for approximately 5 hours per week and will support students in strengthening their vocabulary, grammatical accuracy (particularly tense agreement), reading comprehension, and confidence in spoken English and pronunciation.

Contract Period

Primary (September 2026 – May 2027):
Tuesdays and Fridays, 3:00–4:30pm

Secondary (September 2026 – April 2027):
Thursdays, 3:05–5:05pm

Key Responsibilities

Deliver personalised after-school language intervention sessions for Upper Primary and Lower Secondary students in person at the school campus

Teach classes of approximately 20 students

Design and implement age-appropriate, differentiated lessons for primary and secondary students

Support the development of reading, writing, speaking, and listening skills, with an emphasis on accuracy, confidence, and foundational academic English

Track student progress and adapt instruction to meet learners’ needs

Session Details

3 afternoons per week

Two 1.5-hour sessions a week with Upper Primary students at the Primary Campus (40 sessions in total – exact schedule will be shared at a later date)

One 2-hour session a week with Lower Secondary students at the Secondary Campus (20 sessions in total – exact schedule will be shared in person)

Excludes public and school holidays and special arrangement days as per the school calendar

Requirements

Relevant English language qualifications (e.g. English, TESOL, TEFL, Applied Linguistics, or related discipline)

Experience working with upper primary and/or lower secondary students

Familiarity with supporting language learners or students with low English proficiency

Strong classroom presence and the ability to engage students in structured language learning

A good reference, Sexual Conviction Record Check (SCRC) and no criminal conviction check

Experience in language intervention, learning support, or ESL/EAL contexts will be an advantage.

Job Title: PA to Executive Director (Legal & Compliance Support)

Role Overview

Reporting to the Executive Director and supporting the Personal Assistant to the Group General Manager, the PA will provide structured legal support/ research, branch licensing/compliance assistance, premises search support, and on-site liaison for tenancy and renovation work. This is an execution-and-research role under clear management supervision—final legal opinions, contract decisions, and approvals remain with management or external counsel.

Key Responsibilities

1) Legal Compliance Support & Research (Under Management Supervision)

Conduct preliminary legal research on franchisee and education-related matters, including (but not limited to) the Human Resource Management, Education Ordinance, Employment Ordinance, and Occupiers’ Liability Ordinance for Hong Kong, mainland and overseas.

Review and flag key clauses in documents such as:

tenancy agreements

renovation contracts

service agreements

parent/student handbooks
(All final legal opinions remain with management and/or external counsel.)

Assist in preparing basic legal documents (e.g., license applications, statutory declarations) for management’s final review and signature.

Liaise with external lawyers when instructed (e.g., document delivery, meeting scheduling).

Monitor legislative/regulatory changes affecting private education institutions and provide summaries to the management team.

2) EDB Licensing & Compliance Support

Collect up-to-date licensing and compliance requirements from the Education Bureau and relevant authorities.

Complete application forms and compile submission documents (e.g., floor plans, fire safety records, etc.), and submit for management review and signature.

Track application progress and provide regular updates to the relevant team.

3) Premises Search & Initial Screening

Search for suitable rental units according to the Director’s criteria (e.g., size, budget, catchment area, zoning).

Conduct site visits to take basic evidence (e.g., photos) and record core data.

Prepare comparison tables to assist the Director’s decision-making.

No independent authority to shortlist final premises or sign any tenancy agreement.

4) Liaison for Tenancy & Renovation Works (Execution Support)

Tenancy: arrange site visits with agents, transmit required documents, and follow up on maintenance requests.

Renovation: accompany contractors on site, take measurements/photos, and relay simple instructions (as directed).

Compile communications, quotations, and draft documents, and submit them to management for final approval and signing.

5) Administrative & Field Support

Assist the Personal Assistant to the Group General Manager with HR support, scheduling, meeting minutes, and document preparation.

Perform field duties as assigned (e.g., document delivery, bank errands).

Requirements

Associate degree or above

1+ year experience in administration / legal support / project coordination

Demonstrable legal knowledge, such as:

diploma/degree in legal studies, or

paralegal certificate, or

relevant experience (e.g., contract review, regulatory research)

Knowledge of Hong Kong education / employment / tenancy-related laws is a strong advantage.

Ability to summarise legal information clearly for non-lawyer stakeholders.

Strong communication, documentation, and time-management skills.

Willingness to work on field duties are preferred.

Able to work on Saturdays and/ or Sundays

What We Offer

Clear boundaries and decision control:

You provide research and administrative/execution support.

Legal decisions, contract sign-offs, and policy approvals are made by your management team (or external counsel).

Stable work environment

title: IT Security Operations Analyst (13-month Contract)
label: 运营
full_jd:
Role Introduction
Reports to: IT Security Ops Senior Lead
Department: Information Technology Department
Protect and strengthen Cathay’s technology landscape by taking an active role in day-to-day IT security operations. This position sits at the front line of defence, executing and monitoring security controls across endpoints, networks, privileged access, cloud environments, and software-as-a-service platforms to maintain a strong security posture across the organisation.

Working hands-on with incident response and emerging threat analysis, the role combines operational discipline with analytical thinking. Security requests are reviewed and approved with care, hygiene across the IT security footprint is maintained, and threat hunting techniques are applied to identify and respond to evolving risks. Collaboration is central, involving close engagement with business units, extended IT teams, external security operations centres, and third-party service providers.

Job rotation within IT security operations provides exposure to multiple domains and challenges, building depth and breadth in security expertise. Through investigation, forensics, audit support, and clear documentation, this role contributes directly to safeguarding the systems that keep Cathay moving people forward in life.
Key Responsibilities
• Execute and operate IT security solutions across endpoint, network, privileged access management, cloud, and software-as-a-service security platforms.

• Review and approve IT security requests in line with established policies and controls.

• Maintain strong security hygiene across the company’s IT network and systems.

• Perform basic threat hunting activities to identify and respond to emerging security threats.

• Investigate security incidents, including conducting incident response and forensic analysis.

• Collaborate with business units, extended IT teams, and external partners to address security challenges.

• Coordinate with third-party vendors and external security operations services to support incident response.

• Support audits by collecting evidence, updating documentation, and implementing recommended security controls.

• Develop and maintain documentation and assist in educating stakeholders on security events and their implications.

Requirements
• A minimum of 6 years of overall information technology experience, including at least 3 years of relevant IT security experience.

• Professional certifications such as Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control (CRISC), ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Auditor, or equivalent experience are preferred.

• Demonstrated knowledge of IT security incident investigation and digital forensics.

• Strong understanding of compliance frameworks, including ISO/IEC 27001 and Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS).

• Proven ability to contribute to team development and provide coaching support.

• High level of self-motivation with a commitment to staying current with market standards and security technologies.

• A Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Cyber Security, or an equivalent discipline.

full_jd:
About Smith
Founded in 1984, Smith sources, manages, and distributes the electronic components that go into everything from mobile phones and computers to appliances and automobiles. Smith is the leading independent distributor of electronic components and ranks eighth among all global distributors.
We buy and sell components 24 hours per day, with global sales of USD $3.4 billion in 2025 and in excess of USD $16 billion over the last five years. We’re always moving as we help manufacturers navigate market shifts, customize supply chain solutions, test components using cutting-edge technology, and more.
As a privately held company, Smith employs more than 700 people worldwide, with offices spanning four continents. Our team members are spread out around the world while staying connected to each other, allowing us to provide the expertise of a multinational company while still giving the tailored support of a local business. We have regional headquarters in Houston, Amsterdam, and Hong Kong sales and purchasing offices in Austin, Bangalore, Berlin, Cluj-Napoca, Guadalajara, London, Munich, New York, Penang, São Paulo, Seoul, Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Tokyo, and distribution hubs in Houston, Amsterdam, Hong Kong, and Singapore.
For more information, please visit our company website: https://www.smithweb.com

Responsibilities
• Handle daily logistics operations smoothly, with a strong focus on physical tasks such as unloading, loading, unboxing, and moving inbound shipments.

• Perform order verification and item checking to ensure accuracy of inbound stock.

• Ensure all inbound and outbound shipments comply with relevant customs and regulatory requirements.

• Coordinate and execute in/outbound shipment arrangements, including scheduling, loading preparations, and dispatch processes.

• Prepare shipping and logistics documentation, such as AWB/booking forms, packing lists, commercial invoices, and related paperwork.

• Track and monitor delivery status; proactively resolve shipping or logistics-related issues when they arise.

• Monitor abnormal shipments (e.g., shortages, damages, discrepancies) and follow up promptly with relevant parties.

• Work closely with the Accounting Department to ensure timely settlement of logistics and freight-related payments.

• Collaborate with internal teams to support scheduled shipments, urgent requests, and special handling needs.

• Coordinate with local and international carriers on quotations, shipment bookings, and special freight requirements.

• Handle filing duties, record updates, and other logistics-related administrative tasks.

• Support month-end closing activities.

• Carry out physical warehouse and logistics tasks including lifting, moving, sorting, and organizing goods.

• Overtime may be required during high-volume periods.

• Perform other duties and ad hoc tasks as assigned.

Requirements
• High school graduate or above.

• Fresh graduates are welcome.

• Ability to perform regular lifting, loading, and physical logistics work.

• Good command of written and spoken English, Chinese, and Putonghua.

• Self‑motivated, responsible, well‑organized, and strong in problem-solving.

• A team player with good interpersonal and communication skills.

• Able to work independently and perform under pressure in a fast‑paced environment.

What We Offer
We are committed to driving innovation and embracing diversity. At Smith, you will have the opportunity to expose to new opportunities and express your opinion to drive strategy and better results. We engage our people by our great culture, competitive remuneration, comprehensive fringe benefits, and progressive career opportunities.
• 5-day work week

Our Food Quality team implements solutions for both processes and products that meet customer requirements while ensuring compliance with international regulations and company policies. Talent that we are looking for:
• Take ownership and able to work independently with confidence

• Open-minded, eager to learn with willingness to bring about change

• Energetic to drive for customer success and excellent service

 
Experience, knowledge and skills required:
• Higher Diploma / Degree holder in Food Science, Food and Nutrition or related disciplines.

Join us and apply now!

Company Introduction
METRO (https://www.metroag.de/en/) is a leading international food wholesaler which specialises in serving the needs of hotels, restaurants, and caterers (HoReCa) as well as independent merchants (Traders). Around the world, METRO has approx. 15 million customers who benefit from the wholesale company’s unique multichannel mix: customers can purchase their goods in one of the large stores in their area as well as by delivery (Food Service Distribution, FSD) – all digitally supported and connected. In parallel, METRO MARKETS is being developed as an international online marketplace for the needs of professional customers which has been growing and expanding continuously since 2019. Acting sustainably is one of the company principles of METRO which has been listed in various sustainability indices and rankings, including MSCI, Sustainalytics and CDP. METRO operates in over 30 countries and employs more than 84,000 people worldwide. In the 2024/25 financial year, METRO generated sales of €32.4 billion.
We, METRO Sourcing International Limited (https://www.metro-sourcing.hk/), are the Strategic Buying Organization of METRO. As a professional sourcing organization, METRO Sourcing International provides global sourcing and supply chain solutions of non-food and food to METRO Wholesale as well as third party customers outside METRO.

The ideal candidate will have a strong eye for detail, storytelling ability, and proficiency in video editing software.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities:
• Familiarise with the products and services, the target audience and their competitors’ activities.

• Edit raw footage into polished videos for social media, marketing campaigns, documentaries, commercials, and other projects.

• Trim, splice, and arrange video clips to create a compelling narrative.

• Add music, sound effects, voiceovers, graphics, animations, and subtitles to enhance video content.

• Colour correct and grade footage for a professional look.

• Ensure videos are edited, graded and produced to the branding demands.

• Optimise videos for different platforms (YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, TV, etc.).

• Amend, revise or redevelop adverts or campaigns in response to feedback from the creative director, account team or clients.

• Provide useful thoughtful and constructive contributions to team meetings and conversations.

• Develop creative ideas and concepts, often in partnership with other creative team members.

• Demonstrate strong project management skills: can take ownership of a task/project with excellent attention to detail.

• Maturity of thought and confidence to present and explain ideas to colleagues & management.

• Collaborate with other disciplines including production companies, photographers, designers, copywriters and printers.

• Ability to demonstrate excellence in creativity across multiple media.

Requirements:
• University degree or above in a relevant discipline and at least 2 years experience in equivalent role; or other qualifications plus 3+ years relevant experience.

• Proven experience as a Video Editor with a strong portfolio.

• Familiarity with different video formats, codecs, and export settings.

• Proficiency in video editing software (Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve, After Effects, etc.).

• Knowledge of motion graphics, visual effects, and audio editing.

• Understanding of colour correction and grading techniques.

• Strong storytelling and pacing skills.

• Attention to detail and creative problem-solving abilities.

• Basic knowledge of camera equipment and filming techniques is a plus.

• Self-motivated, creative, independent, able to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines.

• Have a positive and passionate approach with a can-do attitude.

full_jd:
Come and join a Winning Team
We are Awesome!

Why Should You Join Us?
At ASW, we believe in our people, in teamwork and the importance of your personal growth. If you are looking for the opportunity to join our award-winning international family with over 17,000 stores across 31 markets in Asia and Europe, the ASW family welcomes you…

You can enjoy:
• Conveniently located in Whampoa, less than 5 min. walk from MTR

• Cozy office with contemporary design

• Comprehensive Medical and Life insurance coverage, including your spouse and children

Role Purpose:
You play a pivotal role in shaping intuitive, meaningful digital experiences that connect customer needs with business outcomes. By deeply understanding user behaviour and translating insights into elegant solutions, you help put a smile on customers’ faces while enabling our business units to succeed through thoughtful, human‑centred design. Your work directly influences how customers interact with our digital ecosystem across online and offline touchpoints.

​A typical day in this Role:
• Human‑Centred Experience Design: Translate user stories and business requirements into clear user journeys, flows, IA, sitemaps and UI layouts, always applying a strong customer‑focused mindset across O+O (Offline + Online) experiences.

• Rapid Prototyping & Design System Thinking: Create interactive prototypes at varying fidelities and contribute to scalable design systems that balance creativity, usability and technical feasibility in collaboration with product, business and engineering teams.

• Insight‑Driven User Research: Plan and run workshops, stakeholder interviews, surveys, usability testing and A/B testing, applying a scientific and data‑driven approach to uncover behavioural insights and turn them into actionable design solutions.

• Cross‑Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with business stakeholders, product owners, analysts and developers, embedding collaboration as our way of working to deliver seamless end‑to‑end digital experiences.

• UX Craft & Team Enablement: Provide UX guidance and mentorship to junior team members, elevating overall design quality and research maturity within the team.

What This Role Suits In You:
You are someone who consistently demonstrates:
• Strong UX research and experience design capabilities across digital platforms

• Confidence using tools such as Figma, Sketch, Zeplin and Adobe Creative Suite

• A customer‑first mindset with curiosity about user behaviour

• Comfort working within O2O commerce or omnichannel environments

• Clear communication skills in both English and Chinese

• A passion for blending data, creativity and technology to solve real problems

What Drives Success In This Role:
Success depends on consistently demonstrates:
• The ability to turn qualitative and quantitative insights into intuitive digital solutions

• A data‑driven and experimental mindset when validating design decisions

• Strong collaboration across business, product and technology teams

• High standards of UX craft, attention to detail and delivery quality

• A proactive approach to learning, sharing knowledge and mentoring others

• Adaptability and resilience in a fast‑paced digital innovation environment

What is holding you back?
Grasp this opportunity and don't let this great chance to shape your life slip away!

About Cummins AI Lab

The Cummins AI Lab is a global innovation hub dedicated to advancing frontier AI capabilities and deploying AI solutions across Cummins’ engineering, manufacturing, service, and industrial operations worldwide.

We focus on applied LLM research, domain-specific model development, and end-to-end enterprise AI transformation.

We are seeking a Senior LLM Research Scientist to drive advanced research, design next-generation domain LLMs, and influence the AI Lab’s future technical direction.

Role Overview

• This is a senior-level, high-autonomy role requiring deep expertise in large language models, applied AI research, and complex problem-solving. You will explore the latest LLM advancements, design LLM-driven solutions tailored to Cummins’ engineering and industrial scenarios, and play a central role in building our domain-specific enterprise LLM.
• Candidates must demonstrate strong applied research capabilities, cross-disciplinary thinking, and a proven ability to bring research into real-world production.

Key Responsibilities

1. Frontier LLM Research & Technology Exploration
• Investigate state-of-the-art LLM and multimodal technologies: RAG, Agents, tool use, reasoning, alignment, knowledge injection, and domain adaptation.
• Analyze global research trends and define how emerging techniques can be applied to Cummins’ engineering and industrial workflows.
• Lead deep technical explorations and novel architecture experimentation.

2. Domain-Specific LLM Development
• Architect domain-grounded LLM solutions for engineering design, simulation workflows, diagnostics, service operations, manufacturing, and technical documentation.
• Build pipelines for SFT/IFT, retrieval-augmented reasoning, prompt engineering, and knowledge-grounded inference.
• Integrate structured and unstructured engineering knowledge (CAD/CAE outputs, diagnostic logs, manuals, sensor data).

3. Cross-Disciplinary Innovation
• Collaborate with engineering, simulation, materials, control systems, quality, and service teams to design innovative AI workflows.
• Apply multi-domain expertise to create LLM-powered tools for engineering productivity, automated reasoning, and smart decision-making.

4. End-to-End Research Delivery
• Own the full cycle: exploration → prototyping → evaluation → documentation.
• Produce technical reports, architecture designs, and executive-level presentations.
• Provide technical leadership in transitioning prototypes to enterprise systems.

Must-Have Qualifications

• Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, AI, Machine Learning, Engineering, or related fields; OR equivalent senior-level research experience.
• Deep expertise in LLM technologies: Transformer, SFT/IFT, RAG, agents, tool-use, reasoning, alignment, evaluation.
• Proven experience shipping applied AI/LLM systems beyond PoC into real-world environments.
• Strong programming and experimentation skills (Python, PyTorch, HuggingFace, LangChain, LlamaIndex).
• Experience integrating LLMs with engineering, scientific, or industrial domains.
• Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex technical explorations.
• Strong communication skills for working with global research and engineering teams.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in AI Labs, cloud providers, or major technology companies.
• Experience building domain-specific or enterprise LLMs.
• Familiarity with CAD/CAE/PLM systems (Creo, SolidWorks, CATIA, Ansys).
• Publications, patents, or open-source contributions.

What You Will Gain

• Opportunity to shape Cummins’ domain LLM strategy and long-term AI roadmap.
• Work on high-impact problems across engineering, manufacturing, and industrial operations.
• Collaboration with global experts across AI, product, engineering, and platform teams.

We are seeking an experienced and strategic Senior Manager of Clinical Research to lead and execute our clinical study programs. This role is pivotal in designing, managing, and delivering high-quality clinical evidence to achieve regulatory approvals (PMDA,CE,FDA), support product commercialization, and contribute to scientific publications. Key Responsibilities
Clinical Strategy & Study Design
• Contribute to the development of the global clinical evidence strategy for new and existing products.

• Lead the design and development of clinical study protocols, case report forms (CRFs), statistical analysis plans (SAP), and other key study documents.

• Conduct feasibility assessments for new clinical programs.

Study Execution & Management
• Manage the end-to-end execution of multiple clinical studies, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, and in compliance with all regulatory requirements and company SOPs.

• Select, manage, and oversee Contract Research Organizations (CROs), central labs, and other vendors to ensure high-quality performance.

• Serve as the primary point of contact for clinical investigators and site staff.

Regulatory Compliance & Documentation
• Ensure all studies are conducted in accordance with ICH-GCP, ISO 14155, and all applicable global regulations.

• Manage the preparation and submission of essential documents to IRBs/ECs and regulatory authorities.

• Manage regulatory agency and notified body inspections on clinical studies

Data Management & Analysis
• Oversee clinical data management activities to ensure data integrity and quality.

• Collaborate with biostatistics to analyze and interpret clinical data.

• Author, review, and finalize clinical study reports (CSRs).

Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration
• Provide leadership, mentorship, and direction to junior clinical team members.

• Collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders including Corporate Affairs, Investor Relations, R&D, Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance, Medical Affairs.

• Manage the clinical study budget and resources effectively.

• Present clinical strategy and study updates to senior management.

 
Qualifications & Experience
• Bachelor’s degree in a Life Science, Nursing, Engineering, or related field. Advanced degree (MS, PhD, MD) highly preferred.

• Minimum of 5+ years of direct experience in clinical research within the medical device industry (experience with Class II/III devices is essential).

• Proven experience leading and managing all phases of clinical studies (feasibility, start-up, execution, close-out).

• Demonstrated success in contributing to regulatory submissions (PMA, 510(k), IDE, EU MDR) and interacting with regulatory agencies (FDA, notified bodies).

• Deep knowledge of ICH-GCP, ISO 14155, FDA 21 CFR Parts 812, 50, 54, 56, and EU MDR regulations.

• Strong experience in vendor and CRO management.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience authoring protocols, reports

• Valid GCP certificate

• Guide solution teams in building vertically integrated AI applications for Trusted Technologies and FinTech, ensuring technical alignment with the core platform.

• Possess a working knowledge of system deployment architectures and methodologies to guide the team in building solutions that are not only innovative but also feasible for real-world piloting and integration.

• Navigate complex multi-party collaborations, ensuring alignment of interests and smooth project execution.

full_jd:
The Safety, Health and Environment (SHE) Office supports the HKSTP's mission to accelerate technological innovation and commercialization by promoting a safe and healthy environment and ensuring compliance with laws, regulation, and corporate policies. We work closely with our technology clusters and platforms, project development and facility management teams as well as the community around us to strive for excellence.

The Position
Reporting to the Senior Manager, Laboratory and Research Safety, the Manager will support the laboratory and research safety programs to ensure a high standard of compliance across tenant laboratories and central research facilities. The ideal candidate will leverage their own research background to provide practical, science-based safety solutions that support innovation while mitigating risk.

• Advise premises owners/managers in performing risk assessments and make recommendations on appropriate laboratory safety practices
• Perform safety inspections, compliance audits, safety data analysis and hazard assessments of laboratories and central research support facilities, prepare timely reports and monitor remedial actions when necessary
• Design, perform or coordinate environmental or occupational hygiene monitoring; oversee the maintenance and calibration of industrial hygiene instrumentation
• Manage laboratory safety-related documentations, such as licensing/permits/registers for hazardous materials, registration of laboratory users, ensuring the compliance with the local regulations
• Manage and optimize safety database to streamline reporting and tracking of hazardous materials and safety findings
• Prepare and organize various safety trainings for laboratory users
• Assist in emergency response to laboratory-related accidents or incidents, carry out investigations and monitor the implementation of remedial actions
• Perform any other duties as assigned by supervisor.

The Candidate
• Bachelor's Degree in Science or Engineering, preferably in Biological Sciences, Medical Technology, Chemical Engineering, Occupational Hygiene or closely related fields with research experience
• Post-graduate degree in Biotechnology or Engineering is highly desirable to ensure a deep understanding of the research environment
• Minimum 8 years' relevant working experience in laboratory safety. Direct experience in a wet-lab or research setting is an advantage
• Experience in safety database management is a plus, ability to leverage IT tools for data analysis and reporting
• Candidate with less experience may be considered for the position of Assistant Manager, Laboratory and Research Safety
• Higher education or professional qualifications with less experience will also be considered
• Professional qualification(s) in occupational health & safety (e.g. RPH, CIH, CSP or RBP) are highly desirable
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, self-motivated, self-organized and be a good team player
• Proficiency in MS Office applications including Word, Excel, PowerPoint
• Proficiency in both written and spoken English and Chinese (Cantonese and Mandarin)

What We offer

• Unique Work.Live.Play.Learn culture in Hong Kong's largest Innovation & Technology ecosystem

url: https://www.recruit.com.hk/job-detail/easy-property-co-ltd/sales-management-trainee-見習分行經理-物業顧問-兼-職-物-業-顧-問/L0605951716
label: 管培生
full_jd:
機不可失！

不要看扁了地產代理從業員
在一般人印象中，物業代理是一個搵食艱難、為爭客時常大打出手及社會地位低微的職業，這其實是以偏概全的看法及美麗誤會：辣招打遏下，地產代理行業無疑大受打擊，但中長線而言，需要考牌的地產代理始終不失為一個專業和好行業；社會地位的高低及別人對你觀感的好壞，端看你的專業知識及專業操守是否足夠。我們十分有信心，憑著公司所提供的高水平培訓，有才幹的地產代理從業員完全可以以過人的專業知識和操守贏得崇高的社會地位。

怡居擁有九大優點:
 
• 歷史悠久，業績驕人 – 怡居專注經營沙田住宅已經39年，太古城35年，聲譽超著

• 經營的市場大而活躍 – 太古城及沙田每月的物業成交量成交價分別乃港島所有屋邨及新界各區之冠

• 實力過人 – 在王文彥先生領導下，怡居管理完善、架構完備、規制合理，才財兼備

• 盤多客多 – 三間分行雄據太古城及沙田優越位置，盤客俱多，做生意事半功倍

• 報酬特高 – 薪高佣厚，佣金分成尤其領先，以沙田為例，頭四萬元營業額，分佣較區內大行多60%，頭七萬元則多36%

• 資源最足 – 怡居不盲目擴充，屋邨內分行及營業員數目較少，營業員平均分配到的資源(特別是客源)因此最多

• 上位空間大 – 怡居乃仍在發展中的中型公司，許多好職位仍是等待著有才能的人坐上去，員工個人發展空間大

• 提供行內最高水平在職培訓 – 由王文彥先生親自策劃及主持培訓，水平行內最高

• 用升唯才 – 不用擦上司鞋，公司用人升人唯才，不講年資，不論嫡庶

• 上下和洽 – 絕無勾心鬥角之弊，自能提供愉快工作環境，充份發揮團隊精神

見習營業經理和物業顧問的前景：
 
• 怡居地產的最高領導人王文彥先生是中原地產兩位創辦人之一，至今仍擁有中原地產45%股權；

• 怡居地產並不缺乏資金，開100間分行都不成問題，它所缺乏的是一大群能征慣戰的將軍(分行經理)和士兵(物業顧問)。怡居分別招聘及培訓見習分行經理及物業顧問及將他們優化成為出色的分行經理及物業顧問就是要解決這個將才及精英不足的問題；

• 高素質的中層物業代理管理人材是目前本港勞動力市場很難提供的，故此我們寧願自己培訓，並期望將管理培訓班變成香港物業代理界的美國西點軍校。我們相信，所有完成管理培訓課程的畢業生會成為公司及業內管理精英，前程似錦；

•  怡居財、才兼備，有行內少見的巨大發潛力，你有多大的才能，怡居就可為你提供多大的發展舞台。今日是見習分行經理或物業顧問，將來卻可分別成為執行董事和區域經理；

• 怡居的報酬制度，遠勝大行和大多數中小行，有能力的員工，收入自是豐厚過人。

應徵條件：
 
• 應徵見習分行經理的，需具備良好思考及領導能力、勤奮、好學、積極、主動、進取，毋須地産經驗，但對地產和管理工作，有強烈興趣大學程度優先考慮。

• 應徵物業顧問的，擁有營業員牌照，勤奮、主動積極。

應徵兼職物業顧問的，必需：
•  擁有地產代理執業牌照

•  每星期工作6個上午 (9:30am至2:00pm) 或6個下午 (2:30pm至7:00pm)

Sales and Marketing Manager – Polished Diamonds (B2B Luxury & High-End Brand Accounts)

The Role:

We are seeking a highly strategic and commercially astute Sales and Marketing Manager to lead the global sales and brand positioning of our polished diamond inventory. In this critical role, you will be responsible for driving B2B revenue by securing and managing relationships with prestigious luxury jewelry houses, international fashion brands, and high-volume retail chains. You will serve as the key link between our diamond sourcing operations and the exacting procurement standards of top-tier brand clients. You will manage sales pipelines, contract negotiations, marketing collateral, and client-specific quality protocols, ensuring our partners receive consistently graded, conflict-free polished diamonds that meet their design and compliance requirements.

Key Responsibilities:

Strategic Sales & Brand Account Management:

Serve as the primary internal point of contact for all sales and marketing matters related to polished diamonds, specifically regarding the 4Cs, certification standards (GIA/IGI), and parcel consistency required by luxury brand clients.
Develop and manage a detailed annual sales and marketing calendar aligned with diamond trading cycles, luxury fashion showrooms, and peak jewelry retail seasons (e.g., Chinese New Year, Q4 holidays).
Vet all client-specific MOQs, price bands, and quality tolerances during contract negotiation, paying special attention to diamond color and clarity grading, cut precision, and carat weight consistency across repeat orders.
Collaborate with the internal diamond sourcing and production teams to ensure rough or polished diamonds are allocated correctly for specific brand purchase orders (POs) and long-term supply agreements.
Oversee the timely issuance of all sales contracts, proforma invoices, and shipping documentation post-order confirmation, ensuring allocation to appropriate logistics partners based on value, destination, and insurance requirements.

Client Acquisition & Key Account Retention:

Ensure all brand client POs are acknowledged within 24–48 hours and confirmed with signed sales agreements outlining delivery schedules, certification requirements, and payment terms.
Monitor all active client orders and marketing initiatives weekly, ensuring sales targets and delivery timelines stay on track; proactively resolve bottlenecks in certification lead times, parcel sorting, or international shipping.
Ensure GIA/IGI certificate verification and diamond parcel integrity are maintained and transparently communicated to each client before shipment.
Liaise with third-party gemological labs and legal compliance officers to ensure all diamond parcels meet brand-specific ethical sourcing declarations (Kimberley Process, conflict-free guarantees, responsible sourcing reports).
Ensure brand trust and reputation are never compromised; relay any potential roadblocks such as grading discrepancies, supply shortages, or price volatility to senior management immediately with recommended mitigation strategies.
Create and submit invoices for all third-party non-product vendors (e.g., certification labs, secure logistics providers, insurance brokers, marketing agencies).

Brand Marketing & Industry Positioning:

Build and maintain long-term, trust-based relationships with procurement heads, design directors, and supply chain executives at major luxury jewelry houses and fashion brands.
Collaborate with the Sourcing Manager to adjust sales strategies based on market demand, pricing fluctuations in the polished diamond market, and emerging brand preferences (e.g., lab-grown vs. natural, traceability requirements).
Stay informed on Kimberley Process compliance, conflict-free diamond regulations, and emerging ESG (Environmental, Social, Governance) standards to ensure all marketing claims and client reports are legally compliant and competitive.
